name: Sports
tag: Every sport in one place: pick football, cricket, tennis, golf and 11 more, then play, coach or watch
title: Sports

text.TAG: Pick your sport: football, basketball, ice hockey, handball, rugby, cricket (plus the 3D Cricket Championship), baseball, tennis, badminton, table tennis, volleyball, golf, sprinting or swimming. Play as one of the athletes, coach your team, or just watch
text.FREE: Pick any sport and play, coach or watch. No goals
text.WATCH: A tour of the stadium: a football attack, a basketball three, a cricket six and more
text.FOOT: Every athlete runs at real speeds and every ball flies under real gravity. Skill decides who wins the ball.
text.FIND: Find a player, sport or tool…
text.HINT: Pick Play to join in · right-drag to look around
